en_title: Original God of War Creator Defends Laufey's Creative Director From Harassment After His Critical Remarks Go Viral
cn_title: 《战神》创作者为劳菲总监发声
subtitle: 别把批评变成围攻
opus_summary: 《战神》创作者David Jaffe曾在直播中批评《战神：劳菲》及其创意总监Ariel Lawrence，相关言论走红后引发争议。他随后在X上澄清并反对网友骚扰Lawrence，游戏将于2027年2月16日独占登陆PS5。

paragraphs.en: David Jaffe, the creator, co-writer, and director for the original God of War game, has cleared up his viral comments about Ariel Lawrence, creative director for Laufey.
paragraphs.cn: 初代《战神》游戏的创作者、联合编剧兼导演David Jaffe，已经澄清了自己针对《战神：劳菲》创意总监Ariel Lawrence的争议言论。

paragraphs.en: Ariel Lawrence has been with the God of War franchise since its very first game — but creator David Jaffe, who left the series behind in 2007 to form his own studio, says he never got along with her during his time at Santa Monica Studio.
paragraphs.cn: Ariel Lawrence从第一款《战神》开始就参与了这一系列。不过，创作者David Jaffe在2007年离开该系列并创办自己的工作室后表示，自己在圣莫妮卡工作室任职期间始终和她相处不来。

paragraphs.en: He described their contentious work relationship in a September 2026 live stream while reacting to footage for God of War Laufey , where he claimed their personalities clashed and that he didn’t feel as though she was truly passionate about the games they were making.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年9月，Jaffe在直播中观看《战神：劳菲》相关影像时，谈到了两人充满矛盾的工作关系。他声称，两人的性格存在冲突，而且他感觉Lawrence并没有真正热爱他们正在制作的游戏。

paragraphs.en: “I have no problem with female directors at all,” he began. “This woman started as an assistant producer back when we were making the first God of War. Her and I never got along. She thought I was kind of obnoxious and I thought she was pretentious. She didn’t put the audience first.
paragraphs.cn: 他一开始说道：「我完全不反对女性导演。这位女士在我们制作第一款《战神》时，还是一名助理制片人。她和我始终相处不来。她觉得我有点讨厌，而我觉得她很自命不凡。她没有把观众放在首位。」

paragraphs.en: “People that I didn’t get along with on God of War were people, in my opinion, who were more about, ‘I wanna do well in the corporate world… I want to play the game,’ versus, ‘I’m here with a vision and I will f**kin’ fight you for that vision.’ There was a lack of passion I felt from her, and she was also kind of a judgy asshole, to me.”
paragraphs.cn: 「在《战神》项目中，和我相处不来的人，在我看来更在意‘我想在企业世界里混得好……我想玩这场游戏’，而不是‘我带着一个愿景来到这里，我会为了这个愿景和你拼到底’。我觉得她缺少激情，而且在我看来，她也是个喜欢评判别人的混蛋。」

paragraphs.en: Jaffe also slammed Cory Barlog for making Laufey in the first place — which he called a “stupid” game — and asked why he couldn’t “sit Ariel down and say, ‘This isn’t ready.’”
paragraphs.cn: Jaffe还抨击了Cory Barlog制作《战神：劳菲》这件事本身，称这是一款「愚蠢」的游戏，并质问为什么不能「把Ariel叫到面前说，‘这还没准备好’」。

paragraphs.en: Jaffe’s comments unsurprisingly went viral, sparking a debate within the God of War fanbase and the broader gaming community in general. Not long afterward, Jaffe took to Twitter/X to expound upon his remarks, where he called out those using his statement to harass Lawrence online.
paragraphs.cn: Jaffe的言论不出意料地走红，在《战神》粉丝群体以及更广泛的游戏社区中引发了争论。不久后，Jaffe在X上进一步解释了自己的言论，并批评那些利用他的话在网上骚扰Lawrence的人。

paragraphs.en: “Look, I personally didn't like Ariel and I don't THINK she cared much for me back when we worked together. Oil and Water, just very different types of people. And honestly, she was probably more liked on the team than I was. You see, if you haven't noticed, I can be, as my ex-wife says, 'a lot,’” he wrote.
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「听着，我个人不喜欢Ariel，而且我不认为我们共事时她有多喜欢我。我们就像油和水，属于截然不同的两类人。老实说，她在团队里可能比我更受欢迎。你看，如果你还没注意到的话，我这个人可能正如我的前妻所说，‘很难搞’。」

paragraphs.en: “And so in this video, I was responding/sharing that aspect of our time working together. That's the only way I would ever talk about former colleagues, be it good or bad experiences. For people to use my experience with Ariel as an excuse/launching pad to make personal attacks on her is just low and s**tty.
paragraphs.cn: 「所以，在这段视频中，我只是在回应并分享我们共事经历中的这一面。无论过去的经历是好是坏，这都是我谈论前同事时唯一会采用的方式。有人拿我和Ariel的经历当借口或跳板，对她发起人身攻击，这种做法既卑劣又糟糕。」

paragraphs.en: "She's a real person — just like you — with a life and feelings and people who care for her and who love her, and it just seems really f**king cruel to do that. Plus, have you looked in your own mirror? I've looked in mine; that s**t's scary! You see this f**king beard?!? Good lord, I'm days away from moving to the North Pole…”
paragraphs.cn: 「她是一个真实的人，和你一样，有自己的生活和感受，也有在乎她、爱她的人。这样做真的残酷得要命。而且，你照过自己的镜子吗？我照过，我镜子里的样子吓人！你看看我这该死的胡子？！天哪，我再过几天就要搬去北极了……」

paragraphs.en: Look, I personally didn't like Ariel and I don't THINK she cared much for me back when we worked together. Oil and Water, just very different types of people. And honestly, she was probably more liked on the team than I was. You see, if you haven't noticed, I can be, as my… https://t.co/kw0g4JGnMf
paragraphs.cn: 「听着，我个人不喜欢Ariel，而且我不认为我们共事时她有多喜欢我。我们就像油和水，属于截然不同的两类人。老实说，她在团队里可能比我更受欢迎。你看，如果你还没注意到的话，我这个人可能正如我的……」

paragraphs.en: Laufey has, unfortunately, been a target for the online rage machine, and Jaffe's remarks are adding more fuel to the fire. Trolls’ remarks about Deborah Ann Woll’s appearance and their outrage over the fact that a woman is leading a God of War game totally overwhelmed gaming circles on social media when it was first revealed in June, and this finger-pointing doesn’t appear to have stopped, but rather simply slowed down.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，《战神：劳菲》一直是网络怒火机器的攻击目标，而Jaffe的言论又给这场风波添了一把火。6月首次公布该作由女性担任主创时，网络恶意骚扰者对Deborah Ann Woll外貌的评论，以及他们对于女性主导《战神》游戏的愤怒，彻底席卷了社交媒体上的游戏圈。这种相互指责似乎并未停止，只是放慢了速度。

paragraphs.en: Other games have since taken the brunt of the internet’s apparent boredom, as evidenced by the debate surrounding Insomniac’s Wolverine . But still, Laufey has managed to catch strays in this regard, with The Last of Us director Bruce Straley using it as an example of why modern AAA games no longer “excite” him (though he later apologized for this comment ).
paragraphs.cn: 此后，其他游戏也承受了互联网无聊情绪带来的主要冲击，Insomniac的《金刚狼》引发的争论就是例子。不过，《战神：劳菲》仍然因此遭受了无端攻击。《最后生还者》导演Bruce Straley还以该作为例，说明现代3A游戏为何不再让他感到「兴奋」——尽管他后来为这番言论道了歉。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey releases on February 16, 2027, exclusively for PlayStation 5.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》将于2027年2月16日发售，独占登陆PS5。
